CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: stdlib: consolidated 4 real, duplicated C FFI helpers found via an audit for 'one module rolling its own inline-c for something a shared module already provides' -- net/http.prn's i32-to-string (dup of string.prn's), json.prn/yaml.prn's parse-f64-raw (now one shared string/parse-f64-raw), awk.prn/grep.prn's unbox-bool (now shared in regex/pcre.prn), editor/textmate.prn's tm-match-start/tm-match-end (dup of pcre's own match-start-i32/match-end-i32, same underlying Match struct). Verified with real end-to-end targets (test-json/yaml/awk, turbogrep, test-editor-render's real Xvfb render, test-webdriver's real HTTP session), full suite + all 5 selfhost domains clean, zero regressions, CI green on all 4 jobs. PARENA commit d571624, Apple #16392. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
